names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 1745, «Патермуфий Египетский, прп.», with the rank word after the comma left off. The day line gives the bare forename in the genitive with the epithet in the plural, «Патермуфия и Коприя Египетских». THE IDENTICAL STRING is stored on `patermuthius-17-december`, the venerable-martyr of the day’s other entry, because the calendar tells the two men apart by the rank abbreviation alone and a rank is not part of a name; a two-holder `READ_FOLDS` key is written in the same commit.

floruit.note: The century the day line prints for the pair, «(V)». The reading gives no year at all, not of his robber years, his baptism, his withdrawal or his repose. `copres-the-egyptian`, the other man of the same entry, carries «end of the 4th century» off the Охридски пролог instead, and the two intervals abut rather than overlap; that folder’s interval was NOT touched and this one is written from the line this row quotes.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 июля ст. ст. — «Прпп. Патермуфия и Коприя Египетских (V).»

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry, first name, and the one man of the day’s two Patermuthius-and-Coprius entries whom the corpus did not already hold. THE DAY PRINTS TWO ENTRIES, EACH NAMING A PATERMUTHIUS AND A COPRIUS, AND THEY ARE FOUR DIFFERENT MEN WITH FOUR NAME PAGES. The third entry is «Прмчч. Патермуфия , Коприя и мч. Александра (361-363).», the venerable-martyrs under Julian the Apostate, name pages 1744, 1281 and 107; the fourth is «Прпп. Патермуфия и Коприя Египетских (V).», the venerables of the fifth century, name pages 1745 and 1280. Each page lists «День памяти: 9 июля» and no other day, and the two pairs have a reading each, life4200 and life4201, BOTH OPENED. The corpus’s own folders divide the same way: `patermuthius-17-december`, `copris-17-december` and `alexander-17-december` are the martyr trio off saint.gr’s 17 December, and `copres-the-egyptian` is the venerable off doxologia.ro’s and the Охридски пролог’s 9 July. Only the venerable Patermuthius had no folder, and he is the arrival. BECAUSE THE RANK IS WHAT THE CALENDAR USES TO TELL THE PAIRS APART, the stored forms collide once the ranks are stripped, and TWO `READ_FOLDS` KEYS were written in the same commit for the two two-holder folds. THE READING life4201 WAS OPENED: a pagan and the chief of a band of robbers who repented, was baptised and withdrew to the desert, gave the rest of his life to serving the sick and burying the dead, and received from God the gift of wonderworking; and what is known of him is known because Coprius, the presbyter of the same entry, wrote his life and his wonders down and told his own life to the presbyter Rufinus, who passed it to Palladius bishop of Helenopolis for the Лавсаик. `wonderworker` rests on «получил от Бога дар чудотворения» in that reading, which is the one rank word the sources add to «Прпп.»; `venerable` is the line’s own. NO `locations`: Egypt in an epithet and a desert in a narrative are not coordinates. `related` joins him to `copres-the-egyptian`, whom his life names and links, and to nobody else — NOT to the martyr pair of the other entry, who are other men and whose sharing of a day and a name is not a relation. No hymn on the day page stands under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.
